name: Renaming onto an existing business is refused without replacing or merging
description:
Objective: Renaming onto an existing business is refused without replacing or merging.
Preconditions: Open Application editing ownership with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Application editing ownership.
2. Renaming onto an existing business is refused without replacing or merging.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The invalid or unauthorized action is rejected and no unintended state change is made.
